desc.zh: GPT 系列闭源模型官方 API。
desc.en: Official API for the closed-source GPT family.

notes.zh: GPT 系列官方 API，生态兼容最广；Batch API 半价适合离线批处理，用量分级限额随消费自动提升；视觉/音频按 token 另计。全站月访问含 ChatGPT 网页用户。
notes.en: Official GPT API with the widest ecosystem compatibility; Batch API runs offline jobs at half price, usage tiers scale with spend automatically; vision/audio billed per token. Site-wide visits include ChatGPT web users.

desc.zh: Claude 系列官方 API，长文本与代码能力强。
desc.en: Official Claude API; strong at long context and coding.

notes.zh: Claude 系列官方 API，长文本与代码能力公认第一梯队；Prompt 缓存读取最高省 90% 重复输入成本，批量处理五折；Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 三档覆盖旗舰到高性价比。全站月访问含 Claude.ai 网页用户。
notes.en: Official Claude API, a top tier for long context and coding; prompt-cache reads cut repeated input cost by up to 90%, batch saves 50%; Opus/Sonnet/Haiku cover flagship to budget. Site-wide visits include claude.ai web users.

desc.zh: 国产开源权重模型官方 API，性价比极高。

notes.zh: 开源权重模型的官方 API，性价比标杆；工作日 9-12、14-18（北京时间）为高峰，其余时段半价，context caching 自动命中再降成本；完全兼容 OpenAI SDK，迁移零改动。
notes.en: Official API of the open-weight price benchmark; weekdays 9-12 & 14-18 Beijing time are peak, off-peak half price; automatic context caching cuts cost further; fully OpenAI-SDK compatible with zero-migration.

notes.en: Official API of the GLM family, a top Chinese model line; GLM-5.3-Flash at 50% off for a limited time (list CNY 0.8/2.8); context caching and function calling supported, proper invoicing for enterprise procurement.

notes.zh: 阿里云大模型服务平台百炼：Qwen3.8 Max 为当前旗舰（多模态、1M 上下文），官方价 ¥12/¥36，缓存命中仅 ¥1.5（1.25 折）、Batch 输入半价；开源 Qwen 系列与闭源旗舰同平台可调，国内合规发票齐全；国际版 Model Studio 同款 $1.65/$4.95。全站月访问含通义网页用户。
notes.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Qwen3.8 Max is the current flagship (multimodal, 1M context) at CNY 12/36, cache hits just CNY 1.5 (~12.5% of list) and batch input half price; open-weight Qwen models and closed flagships share one platform with proper invoicing in China; the global Model Studio lists the same model at $1.65/$4.95. Monthly visits include Tongyi web users.

desc.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi 系列官方 API，主打长上下文与 Agentic 能力。
desc.en: Official Kimi API by Moonshot AI, focused on long context and agentic workflows.

note.zh: 旗舰，长程编码与 Agent 任务；缓存命中 ¥2
note.en: flagship for long-horizon coding and agent tasks; cache hit ¥2

cache.en: Cache hit ¥2/M tokens; cache write ¥40 (1h TTL, refreshed on hit)

notes.zh: Kimi 系列官方 API：K3 主打 1M tokens 长上下文、长程编码与 Agent 任务；国内站人民币计价（¥20/¥100），国际站等值 $3/$15；上下文缓存命中仅 ¥2、写入 ¥40（1 小时有效），适合高频重复前缀场景。全站月访问含 Kimi 网页助手用户。
notes.en: Official Kimi API: K3 targets 1M-token long context, long-horizon coding and agent tasks; CNY billing on the China site (¥20/¥100), international site at $3/$15 equivalent; context cache hits cost just ¥2 (write ¥40, 1h TTL), ideal for repeated prefixes. Monthly visits include Kimi web assistant users.

desc.zh: Google Gemini 系列官方 API，多模态与长上下文见长。
desc.en: Official Gemini API by Google, strong in multimodality and long context.

note.en: flagship reasoning; intro price through 2026-11-30, then $4/$20 from Dec 1; cache read $0.10 (implicit only)

notes.en: Official Gemini API: 3.8 Flash targets long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents and enterprise workflows, at an intro price of $0.75/$3.75 (through 2026-12-31, then $1.5/$7.5); the AI Studio free tier is usable for testing but data improves Google products; Grounding with Google Search includes 5,000 free requests/month, then $14 per 1,000. Monthly visits include Gemini web users.

desc.zh: xAI 的 Grok 系列官方 API。
desc.en: Official Grok API by xAI.

notes.en: Official Grok API: 4.7 is the current flagship (released 2026-09) for coding, agents and general text, priced the same as Grok 4.6 at $2/$6; cache hits $0.50; 500K context window suits long documents and agent tasks. OpenRouter and OfoxAI list it at the same price. Monthly visits include Grok web users.

notes.zh: OpenCode 团队官方模型网关（与开源 Agent 工具 OpenCode 同团队）：模型针对编程 Agent 场景实测筛选、与提供商确认交付质量，宣称按请求计费零加价；$20 即用即付、余额低于 $5 自动充值，可设月度消费限额；可配合 Claude Code、Codex 等任意 Agent；上游零留存、不用数据训练（个别例外见官网隐私节）；部分长上下文档另有加价档。
notes.en: Official model gateway from the OpenCode team (same team as the open-source agent): models vetted for coding agents with delivery confirmed per provider, advertised zero markup on pay-per-request; $20 top-up, auto-recharge below $5, monthly spend caps; works with any agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.); upstream zero-retention, no training on your data (few exceptions, see privacy docs); some long-context tiers priced higher.

desc.en: One API for hundreds of models at upstream list prices.

notes.en: The largest model aggregator: one API for hundreds of models at upstream list prices; auto-routing to the cheapest available provider with failover, free tiers on popular models; crypto top-up supported.

notes.en: Publicly endorsed by TRON founder Justin Sun (featured by 36Kr): blockchain login with anonymous USDT crypto payment, claims the lowest prices around; positions itself as financial infrastructure for the AI-agent era with the x402 payment protocol. Third-party relay; do not deposit large amounts.

notes.en: Open-source model inference cloud: serverless on-demand plus dedicated endpoints, hosting hundreds of open models incl. DeepSeek & FLUX; per-second billing suits batch jobs, fine-tuning also available.

notes.en: Proprietary LPU chips deliver extremely low first-token latency and high throughput, ideal for real-time and high-concurrency workloads; free tier available, but hosted models have shorter context.

desc.zh: 开源模型托管，企业级 SLA。
desc.en: Open-model hosting with enterprise SLA.

notes.en: Enterprise-grade inference cloud: serverless and dedicated (incl. private) deployment with enterprise SLA; fine-tuning and one-click model deployment, a common choice for production GenAI.

notes.en: One of the largest Chinese inference platforms for open models, hosting DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen and more, with free tiers on small models; direct access within China, CNY payment and invoicing supported.

desc.zh: 聚合 GPT/Claude/Gemini 的折扣网关。
desc.en: Discount gateway aggregating GPT/Claude/Gemini.

note.en: same as official intro price (Google Vertex upstream; site's 50% off is vs Dec list price)

notes.zh: 全球首个推出「AI 保险」的聚合网关：自动检测幻觉、输出质量差、高延迟等问题，次日自动赔付额度——第三方评测称「这是同行里没人敢公开承诺的」；双协议兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 标准，无缝对接 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具；ZenMux Auto 智能路由按质量/成本选模型（客户实测约省 20%）；SOC2 合规推进中。第三方中转，勿充大额。
notes.en: First gateway with an "AI insurance" scheme: hallucinations, poor output and high latency are auto-detected and compensated as credits the next day — reviewers call it "a promise nobody else in the gateway business makes out loud"; dual OpenAI + Anthropic protocol for Claude Code, Cursor etc.; ZenMux Auto routes by quality/cost, reportedly cutting spend ~20%; SOC2 in progress. Third-party relay; do not deposit large amounts.

notes.en: Marketed as "one API to route all LLMs": unlimited concurrency, fully OpenAI-compatible with zero-code switching, continuously optimized routes; 27+ genuinely free models subsidized by the platform (incl. GPT-5.5, Gemini 3, GLM); 10% off spending in partner app ecosystems via APP-Code; no subscription, pay as you go; active blog and docs. Third-party relay; do not deposit large amounts.

Claude Code & Codex; claims 6,000+ teams, 1T+ tokens routed daily and 99.98% routing SLA; pay-as-you-go in USD, no minimum spend, Alipay supported. Third-party relay; do not deposit large amounts.

Claude Code & Codex; strong on video/image models (Seedance from $0.11/s, images from $0.03); publishes verifiable platform-wide token usage rankings.
